build_reitanet_model: build a RetinaNet object detection model from a detectron2 configuration
create_retinanet_head: create a RetinaNetHead with classification and bounding-box regression subnets
run_loss_computation: run focal classification loss and box regression loss for training RetinaNet
test_anchor_labeling: test anchor labeling by matching anchors to ground truth instances via IoU
run_inference_single_image: run single-image inference with score thresholding and NMS on RetinaNet predictions
